beats.say: Velcro exists because someone grabbed the wrong spool.
Swiss inventor George de Mestral wanted to copy the tiny hooks on a burr.
But hooks need a thread that bends, then holds its shape once heated.
He said a storeroom worker sent the wrong thread by mistake, and the one they ordered would never have worked.
One wrong spool. Next time you rip open a strap, thank a storeroom.
